modern: One thing only troubles me: that I might do something which the constitution of man does not allow, or in a way which it does not allow, or which it does not allow now.
original: One thing only troubles me, lest I should do something which the constitution of man does not allow, or in the way which it does not allow, or what it does not allow now.
